title: Security rule registry
description: data-pack/security/rules.json — the frozen rule ids, their severities, and the append-only id ledger (RM-38 D-DP6/D-DP7, RM-20 D-SP2/D-SP5). The analyzers implement these; this file declares them. A rule id is frozen the moment it ships: a renamed id reads to a CI gate as one finding resolved plus one appearing, which is exactly the false alarm that teaches an operator to ignore the gate.

analyzerVersion.description: Bumped when a rule's MEANING changes, a weight changes, or the report shape changes — whenever two reports would no longer be comparable. A pack whose severities differ from the bundled registry MUST carry a greater value here (D-DP7).

idLedger.description: Every rule id ever shipped, append-only. A pack that drops, renames or re-points a ledger id is refused whole (D-DP6).

rules.description: The rules currently implemented, in declaration order. `SECURITY_RULE_IDS` is this order, and reports iterate it.

rationale.description: WHY this matters and what to do, written for the person who has to fix the server. A rule with a vague rationale is a rule that gets ignored, which is why there is a length floor.

deprecated.description: Set instead of deleting a rule that no longer makes sense. Its id is never reused.
